title: Comparative Study of Canvas- and Coordinate-Based Geometry-Conditioned Neural Networks for Real-Time Prediction of Indoor Environments with Varying Room Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2610.15885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is computationally expensive for iterative building design. Deep learning surrogates offer faster predictions, but generalization across varying room dimensions remains challenging. This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogate models for rapid indoor airflow and temperature field prediction under varying room sizes. During the architectural design stage, this method is relevant for real-time assessment of whether conditioned supply air will effectively provide fresh and cool air throughout rooms with varying heights and lengths. The canvas-based neural network (CaNN) explicitly encodes room size by preserving different occupied regions within a fixed canvas, whereas the coordinate-based neural network (CoNN) uses normalized coordinate channels. translated_title: 基于画布与坐标的几何条件神经网络在变化房间尺寸室内环境实时预测中的比较研究
translated_abstract: 计算流体力学（CFD）对于迭代式的建筑设计而言计算成本高昂。深度学习代理模型能够提供更快的预测，但在不同房间尺寸之间的泛化仍然是一个挑战。本研究比较了两种几何条件神经网络代理模型，用于在不同房间尺寸下快速预测室内气流场和温度场。在建筑设计阶段，该方法可用于实时评估经调节的送风能否有效地为不同高度和长度的房间提供新鲜、凉爽的空气。基于画布的神经网络通过在固定画布内保留不同的占用区域来显式编码房间尺寸，而基于坐标的神经网络则使用归一化坐标通道。两者均采用 U-Net 自编码器分别预测气流场和温度场。评估使用具有不同高度的简化房间进行（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究比较了两种几何条件神经网络代理模型——通过固定画布内占用区域显式编码房间尺寸的画布神经网络与使用归一化坐标通道的坐标神经网络，二者均基于 U-Net 自编码器，实现对不同房间尺寸下室内气流场和温度场的快速实时预测，以支持建筑设计阶段的送风效果评估。
en_tdlr: This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogates—a canvas-based network (CaNN) that explicitly encodes room size via occupied regions in a fixed canvas and a coordinate-based network (CoNN) using normalized coordinate channels—both employing U-Net autoencoders for real-time prediction of indoor airflow and temperature fields across varying room dimensions.
